question.t: 在 Design Tokens 的三層架構中，為什麼我們不建議直接在元件（如 `.button`）中使用 `var(--blue-500)` 這類 Primitive Tokens？
question.en: In the three-tier structure of Design Tokens, why is it not recommended to use Primitive Tokens like `var(--blue-500)` directly in components (e.g., `.button`)?

options.t: 因為 Primitive Tokens 的瀏覽器支援度較差。
options.en: Because Primitive Tokens have poor browser support.

options.t: 因為這樣會導致 CSS 檔案過大。
options.en: Because this will cause the CSS file to become too large.

options.t: 因為這跳過了語意層（Semantic Layer），使得實作 Dark Mode 或更換品牌主題時，必須逐一修改元件程式碼。
options.en: Because it skips the Semantic Layer, making it necessary to modify component code one by one when implementing Dark Mode or rebranding.

options.t: 因為 Primitive Tokens 只能在 `:root` 中定義，無法在元件層級讀取。
options.en: Because Primitive Tokens can only be defined in `:root` and cannot be read at the component level.

why.t: 這是所謂的「直通陷阱」（Pass-through Trap）。Semantic Tokens 的作用是提供一層抽象（API），讓你可以透過改變映射關係（例如在 Dark Mode 下將 Action Color 映射到淺藍色）來切換主題，而無需觸碰元件本身的 CSS。
why.en: This is known as the 'Pass-through Trap'. The role of Semantic Tokens is to provide a layer of abstraction (API), allowing you to switch themes by changing the mapping (e.g., mapping Action Color to a lighter blue in Dark Mode) without touching the component's CSS itself.

question.t: 若要實作深色模式（Dark Mode），下列哪一種 CSS 定義方式最符合「主題即上下文切換（Theming as Context Switching）」的心智模型？
question.en: To implement Dark Mode, which of the following CSS definitions best fits the mental model of 'Theming as Context Switching'?

options.t: 直接修改 `.card` 或 `.button` 等元件的 CSS，針對深色模式寫新的樣式規則。
options.en: Directly modify the CSS of components like `.card` or `.button` and write new style rules for dark mode.

options.t: 在 `[data-theme="dark"]` 區塊中，重新定義 `--bg-page` 與 `--text-primary` 的值（映射到適合深色的 Primitives）。
options.en: Inside the `[data-theme="dark"]` block, redefine the values of `--bg-page` and `--text-primary` (mapping them to dark-appropriate Primitives).

options.t: 在 `[data-theme="dark"]` 區塊中，重新定義 `--gray-900` 為白色，`--white` 為黑色。
options.en: Inside the `[data-theme="dark"]` block, redefine `--gray-900` to be white and `--white` to be black.

options.t: 使用 JavaScript 偵測主題切換，並動態修改所有 DOM 元素的 `style` 屬性。
options.en: Use JavaScript to detect theme switching and dynamically modify the `style` attribute of all DOM elements.

why.t: 正確的做法是在特定的 Scope（如 `[data-theme="dark"]`）下重新映射 Semantic Tokens。選項 2 修改 Primitive 的定義（把 gray-900 變白）會造成命名與視覺不符的混亂；選項 0 與 3 則違背了 Design System 的維護性原則。
why.en: The correct approach is to remap Semantic Tokens within a specific Scope (like `[data-theme="dark"]`). Option 2 (redefining Primitives, e.g., making gray-900 white) causes confusion where names don't match visuals; Options 0 and 3 violate Design System maintainability principles.

question.t: 根據 CTI (Category-Type-Item) 命名慣例，下列哪一個變數名稱最能清楚描述「主要按鈕在 Hover 狀態下的文字顏色」？
question.en: According to the CTI (Category-Type-Item) naming convention, which variable name best describes the 'text color of a primary button in hover state'?

options.t: `--hover-button-primary-text`
options.en: `--hover-button-primary-text`

options.t: `--text-color-primary-button-hover`
options.en: `--text-color-primary-button-hover`

options.t: `--color-text-primary-hover`
options.en: `--color-text-primary-hover`

options.t: `--primary-btn-text-hover-color`
options.en: `--primary-btn-text-hover-color`

why.t: CTI 結構通常為 Category (color) -> Type (text) -> Item (primary) -> State (hover)。選項 2 最符合此結構，能有效分類變數並降低溝通成本。
why.en: The CTI structure is typically Category (color) -> Type (text) -> Item (primary) -> State (hover). Option 2 fits this structure best, effectively categorizing variables and reducing communication costs.

question.t: 當你需要為 `.alert-box` 建立一個 `danger` 變體（Variant），且不希望影響全域 Semantic Tokens 時，下列哪種寫法最符合「元件層級變數隔離」的最佳實務？
question.en: When you need to create a `danger` variant for `.alert-box` without affecting global Semantic Tokens, which approach best follows the best practice of 'Component-Level Token Isolation'?

options.t: `.alert-box.danger { background: red; }` - 直接覆寫屬性。
options.en: `.alert-box.danger { background: red; }` - Directly override the property.

options.t: `.alert-box.danger { --bg-surface: var(--color-danger-bg); }` - 修改繼承來的 Semantic Token。
options.en: `.alert-box.danger { --bg-surface: var(--color-danger-bg); }` - Modify the inherited Semantic Token.

options.t: `.alert-box.danger { --alert-bg: var(--color-danger-bg); }` - 更新 Component Token 的值。
options.en: `.alert-box.danger { --alert-bg: var(--color-danger-bg); }` - Update the value of the Component Token.

options.t: 建立一個全新的 class `.danger-box`，並複製所有樣式。
options.en: Create a brand new class `.danger-box` and duplicate all styles.

why.t: 最佳做法是更新 Component Token (`--alert-bg`) 的映射。選項 1 會汙染 `--bg-surface`，導致該元件內其他使用此變數的子元素也意外變紅；選項 0 破壞了 Token 系統的一致性；選項 3 造成程式碼重複。
why.en: The best practice is to update the mapping of the Component Token (`--alert-bg`). Option 1 pollutes `--bg-surface`, causing other child elements using this variable to unexpectedly turn red; Option 0 breaks the consistency of the Token system; Option 3 causes code duplication.

question.t: 為什麼 `--main-color` 這類命名被視為 Design Systems 中的 Anti-pattern（反模式）？
question.en: Why is naming like `--main-color` considered an Anti-pattern in Design Systems?

options.t: 因為它不夠簡短，應該用 `--mc`。
options.en: Because it's not short enough; it should be `--mc`.

options.t: 因為它語意模糊（Vague Naming）。當設計需求變更（例如背景要變黑但按鈕保持藍色）時，無法區分該變數到底是指背景、文字還是品牌色。
options.en: Because it has vague naming. When design requirements change (e.g., background becomes black but buttons stay blue), it's impossible to distinguish whether the variable refers to background, text, or brand color.

options.t: 因為 CSS 變數不支援連字號開頭。
options.en: Because CSS variables do not support starting with hyphens.

options.t: 因為它直接使用了顏色數值。
options.en: Because it directly uses color values.

why.t: 「Main」無法描述用途。在 Design System 中，變數名稱應該描述「意圖」（Intent），如 `--bg-page` 或 `--brand-primary`，以避免在主題切換或設計迭代時發生衝突。
why.en: 'Main' does not describe usage. In a Design System, variable names should describe 'Intent' (e.g., `--bg-page` or `--brand-primary`) to avoid conflicts during theme switching or design iterations.

question.t: 在 Code Review 時看到上述程式碼，身為資深工程師，你應該提出什麼建議？
question.en: When seeing the above code during a Code Review, what suggestion should you make as a senior engineer?

options.t: 建議將 `px` 改為 `em` 以支援響應式設計。
options.en: Suggest changing `px` to `em` to support responsive design.

options.t: 建議使用 `calc()` 來動態計算這些數值。
options.en: Suggest using `calc()` to dynamically calculate these values.

options.t: 指出這些是 Magic Numbers，應替換為 Design System 定義的 Spacing Tokens（如 `--space-3`, `--space-5`）以確保視覺韻律一致。
options.en: Point out that these are Magic Numbers and should be replaced with Spacing Tokens defined in the Design System (e.g., `--space-3`, `--space-5`) to ensure consistent visual rhythm.

options.t: 數值沒有問題，只要設計師是這樣畫的。
options.en: The values are fine as long as the designer drew them that way.

why.t: 隨意的數值（Magic Numbers）會破壞 UI 的一致性與韻律感。Design System 應提供一組 Spacing Scale（空間系統），強制所有間距都落在該系統的倍數上。
why.en: Arbitrary values (Magic Numbers) break UI consistency and rhythm. A Design System should provide a Spacing Scale, enforcing all spacing to fall on multiples of that system.

keywords: Dark Mode, Debugging, Pass-through Trap, CSS Variables

question.t: 開發者回報 `.card` 元件在切換到深色模式（Dark Mode）時，背景顏色沒有正確變深。請根據上述程式碼判斷問題出在哪裡？
question.en: A developer reports that the `.card` component does not correctly darken its background when switching to Dark Mode. Based on the code above, what is the cause of the issue?

options.t: CSS 變數不支援在 `.card` 類別中直接使用，必須透過 `:root` 定義。
options.en: CSS variables cannot be used directly in the `.card` class; they must be defined in `:root`.

options.t: 這是一個「直通陷阱（Pass-through Trap）」：元件直接使用了 Primitive Token，繞過了負責切換主題的 Semantic Layer。
options.en: This is a "Pass-through Trap": the component directly uses a Primitive Token, bypassing the Semantic Layer responsible for theme switching.

options.t: 深色模式的選擇器優先級（Specificity）不足，導致變數未被正確覆寫。
options.en: The specificity of the Dark Mode selector is insufficient, causing the variable not to be overridden correctly.

options.t: `[data-theme="dark"]` 必須定義在 `.card` 內部才能生效。
options.en: `[data-theme="dark"]` must be defined inside `.card` to take effect.

why.t: 問題在於 `.card` 直接使用了 `--gray-100`（Primitive Token）。由於 Primitive Token 的值是固定的（#f3f4f6），無論父層主題如何切換，它都不會改變。正確做法是使用 `--bg-surface`（Semantic Token），該變數會隨主題切換而指向不同的 Primitive 值。
why.en: The issue is that `.card` directly uses `--gray-100` (a Primitive Token). Since the value of a Primitive Token is fixed (#f3f4f6), it does not change regardless of the parent theme. The correct approach is to use `--bg-surface` (a Semantic Token), which points to different Primitive values depending on the active theme.

question.t: 在 Design Systems 中，關於「排版（Typography）」的 Token 化策略，下列敘述何者最符合最佳實務？
question.en: In Design Systems, which of the following statements best aligns with best practices for tokenizing 'Typography'?

options.t: 應將 `font-size`, `font-weight`, `line-height` 拆分為完全獨立的變數，並在每個元件中自由組合使用。
options.en: Should split `font-size`, `font-weight`, and `line-height` into completely independent variables and combine them freely in every component.

options.t: 排版通常被視為「複合 Token（Composite Tokens）」，建議透過 Utility Class 或 Mixin 一次應用整組樣式（包含大小、行高、字重），以確保閱讀韻律。
options.en: Typography is usually treated as "Composite Tokens". It is recommended to apply the entire set of styles (including size, line height, weight) at once via Utility Classes or Mixins to ensure reading rhythm.

options.t: 只須定義 `font-size` 的 Token，`line-height` 應一律設為 `1.5` 以簡化系統。
options.en: Only `font-size` tokens need to be defined; `line-height` should always be set to `1.5` to simplify the system.

options.t: 排版樣式不應使用 CSS 變數，應直接使用瀏覽器預設值以提升效能。
options.en: Typography styles should not use CSS variables; browser defaults should be used directly to improve performance.

why.t: 文字的可讀性高度依賴字級與行高的搭配（例如大標題需要較緊的行高，內文需要較鬆的行高）。將它們視為一組複合屬性（Composite）來管理，能避免開發者隨意組合導致視覺不協調。
why.en: Text readability relies heavily on the pairing of font size and line height (e.g., large headings need tighter line heights, while body text needs looser ones). Managing them as a composite set prevents developers from creating arbitrary combinations that result in visual inconsistency.

question.t: 在 Code Review 時看到上述變數定義，這反映了哪一種 Design System 的反模式（Anti-pattern），以及它會造成什麼後果？
question.en: Upon seeing the above variable definitions during a Code Review, which Design System anti-pattern does this reflect, and what is the consequence?

options.t: 這是「直通陷阱（Pass-through Trap）」，會導致深色模式失效。
options.en: This is the "Pass-through Trap", which causes Dark Mode to fail.

options.t: 這是「過度 Token 化（Over-tokenization）」，會導致變數檔過於龐大且難以維護，且失去了一致性規範的意義。
options.en: This is "Over-tokenization", which leads to a bloated and unmaintainable variable file, losing the purpose of consistency standards.

options.t: 這是「模糊命名（Vague Naming）」，因為變數名稱不夠具體。
options.en: This is "Vague Naming" because the variable names are not specific enough.

options.t: 這是「忽略回退值（Ignoring Fallbacks）」，會導致瀏覽器渲染錯誤。
options.en: This is "Ignoring Fallbacks", which causes browser rendering errors.

why.t: 為每一個微小的像素差異或特定元件建立專屬變數（如 42px, 18px）是過度 Token 化。正確做法是建立通用的 Spacing/Sizing Scale（如 `--space-4`, `--space-5`），讓元件去選用這些標準值，以保持設計的一致性與可維護性。
why.en: Creating exclusive variables for every tiny pixel difference or specific component (like 42px, 18px) is Over-tokenization. The correct approach is to establish a generic Spacing/Sizing Scale (e.g., `--space-4`, `--space-5`) and have components select from these standard values to maintain design consistency and maintainability.

question.t: 假設 `--text-primary` 在當前作用域中**未被定義**，且沒有提供 fallback 值。瀏覽器會如何處理 `.text-content` 的顏色？
question.en: Assuming `--text-primary` is **undefined** in the current scope and no fallback value is provided, how will the browser handle the color of `.text-content`?

options.t: 視為語法錯誤，該行 CSS (`color: ...`) 會被忽略，元素將呈現瀏覽器預設樣式。
options.en: It is treated as a syntax error; the CSS line (`color: ...`) is ignored, and the element renders with browser default styles.

options.t: 使用 `Unset` 行為：若該屬性會繼承（如 color），則繼承父層的值；若不會繼承，則使用初始值（Initial Value）。
options.en: Uses `Unset` behavior: if the property is inherited (like color), it inherits the parent's value; otherwise, it uses the Initial Value.

options.t: 自動使用黑色 (`#000000`) 作為預設值。
options.en: Automatically uses black (`#000000`) as the default value.

options.t: 該元素會完全隱藏（`display: none`）。
options.en: The element will be completely hidden (`display: none`).

why.t: 當 `var()` 引用的變數未定義且無 fallback 時，該屬性會被視為 `unset`。對於 `color` 屬性，這意味著它會繼承父層顏色；對於非繼承屬性（如 `background-color`），則會變為 `transparent`（初始值）。這常導致 UI 壞掉但沒有明顯錯誤訊息。
why.en: When a variable referenced by `var()` is undefined and has no fallback, the property is treated as `unset`. For the `color` property, this means it inherits the parent's color; for non-inherited properties (like `background-color`), it becomes `transparent` (the initial value). This often leads to broken UI without obvious error messages.

question.t: 在上述結構中，`.text` 的文字顏色會是什麼？這展示了 CSS 變數的什麼特性？
question.en: In the structure above, what will be the text color of `.text`? What characteristic of CSS variables does this demonstrate?

options.t: 黑色 (#000)。因為 `body` 是最外層，其定義的變數優先權最高。
options.en: Black (#000). Because `body` is the outermost layer, its variable definition has the highest priority.

options.t: 白色 (#fff)。因為 CSS 變數依賴 DOM 結構的繼承與作用域（Scope），`.sidebar` 重新定義了該變數，子元素會使用最近的定義。
options.en: White (#fff). Because CSS variables rely on DOM structure inheritance and Scope, `.sidebar` redefines the variable, and child elements use the nearest definition.

options.t: 瀏覽器預設顏色。因為不能在子元素中重新定義同名變數。
options.en: Browser default color. Because you cannot redefine a variable with the same name in a child element.

options.t: 取決於 CSS 檔案中 `[data-theme="dark"]` 與 `[data-theme="light"]` 的書寫順序。
options.en: Depends on the writing order of `[data-theme="dark"]` and `[data-theme="light"]` in the CSS file.

why.t: 這正是「主題即上下文切換（Theming as Context Switching）」的核心。CSS 變數解析時會查找 DOM 樹中最近的祖先節點定義。因此，即使全站是 Light Mode，只要在某個容器上加上 `data-theme="dark"` 並重新映射 Semantic Tokens，內部元件就會自動套用深色樣式。
why.en: This is the core of "Theming as Context Switching". When resolving CSS variables, the browser looks for the definition in the nearest ancestor node in the DOM tree. Therefore, even if the site is in Light Mode, adding `data-theme="dark"` to a container and remapping Semantic Tokens will automatically apply dark styles to internal components.

why.en: JSON is a platform-agnostic data format suitable for storing token names and values. Tools (like Style Dictionary) can use this JSON to automatically generate code required for different platforms such as Web (CSS/Sass), iOS (Swift), and Android (XML).
